objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the SQL injection weakness of a FastAPI job search backed by SQLite, with an allowlist filter on the search words and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Find which input ends up inside the SQL query without being bound as a parameter.
Note every numeric or encoded identifier the application sends, and whether the server checks that it belongs to you.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which injection class does the vulnerable query suffer from?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which access-control weakness lets you reach another account's objects by changing an identifier?
